calibrated_pair_geometry.method: Normalize each of the six Q15 harmonic components by their sum, as in the detector; compute squared Euclidean distance and its quarter-distance bound. No audio replay or threshold change.
calibrated_pair_geometry.bound: For a convex two-template least-squares mixture, improvement over its best endpoint is at most squared template distance / 4. The best of all single templates cannot have greater error than that endpoint, so the same upper bound applies to the first-addition gain.
calibrated_pair_geometry.finding: For note 52, a first addition combining strings 4 and 5 cannot reach the 0.010 gain floor: its upper bound is 0.0005963218684316344. Removing only the 0.0025 distance gate would not admit this pair.
calibrated_pair_geometry.scope: A limitation of the current calibrated first-addition rule; not proof of physical unidentifiability, every assignment path, or measured labeled-note improvement.
